steps.content:
I'd say neither seller is better, based on these two pages. The listings match on everything I could see:

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Box contents and specs | Same | Same |

The rating and review count are identical. That may mean the reviews are for the product as a whole and not for each seller, so they probably don't tell you how either seller performs.

Some ways to decide:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own reviews on an independent site. Check for complaints about shipping delays, refunds or counterfeit goods.
- **Payment protection:** Use a credit card or PayPal so you can dispute the charge if something goes wrong.
- **Final checkout:** Check the total at checkout in case tax or fees differ. Also check whether either seller offers a coupon or a price match.
- **Return policy:** Both make you pay return shipping, so keep that cost in mind if you're unsure about the headphones.

If you still can't choose, either one is a reasonable pick. If you tell me which seller you already know or trust, or where you found these links, I can help you narrow it down.
